paraphrase: Given the reaffirmed possible beginning under the revised κ/complement classification and the retained possible-event-causability report, the source applies its causal prefix to that revised class: a possible SAME essential-state event changes from no revised contingent things to some; it asserts a possible prior cause, excludes a cause in the revised contingent complement and infers a possible cause in the revised must-exist class, hence a possible Necessary Being in that sense. This records the author’s conditional argument, not its soundness, an actual event/cause or a rigid actual necessary witness. Earlier existence of a concrete causal bearer and persistence of the revised classification are not supplied by the word prior alone.
